description: One phase with FR-001, FR-002, NFR-001 and no codebase. Tasks have all five parts, every ID is covered, every Done when cites an ID, every file is new, and the phase ends with a verify task.

must_match.why: the reply is the tasks alone: it starts at the Overview heading
the Overview says there is no codebase

must_not_match.why: every Done when cites a requirement ID
a check a reviewer can run or see
with no codebase, no file path is named
no Revision History, closing note, or rule in a chat reply

expectations: No task depends on a later task, and each requirement's check is in the task that builds it or an earlier task, not only in a final task.
No requirement is added, reworded, or split, and no task is a layer such as Database or UI.
manual: Each task is one focused change.
